# Nehemiah Chapter 3 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 471r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/NEH_003_page_001.jpg

---

**3:1** And-arose Elyashiv the-high-priest [ha-kohen ha-gadol] and-his-brothers the-priests, and-they-built the-Sheep Gate [Sha'ar ha-Tson]. They sanctified-it [qiddishuhu] and-set-up its-doors [dalotav], and-unto the-Tower of-the-Hundred [Migdal ha-Me'ah] they-sanctified-it, unto the-Tower of-Chanan'el [Migdal Chanan'el].

**3:2** And-beside-him [al yado] built the-men of-Yericho. And-beside-him built Zakkur son of-Imri.

**3:3** And-the-Fish Gate [Sha'ar ha-Dagim] the-sons of-ha-Sena'ah built; they laid-its-beams [qeruhu] and-set-up its-doors, its-bolts [man'ulav] and-its-bars [u-verichav].

**3:4** And-beside-them repaired [hecheziq] Meremot son of-Uriyyah son of-ha-Qots. And-beside-them repaired Meshullam son of-Berekhyah son of-Meshezav'el. And-beside-them repaired Tsadoq son of-Ba'ana.

**3:5** And-beside-them the-Teqo'im repaired, but-their-nobles [addireyhem] did-not bring [lo hevi'u] their-necks [tsavvaram] to-the-work [ba-avodat] of-their-lords [adoneyhem].

**3:6** And-the-Yeshanah Gate [Sha'ar ha-Yeshanah] — Yoyada son of-Pase'ach and-Meshullam son of-Besodyah repaired; they laid-its-beams and-set-up its-doors and-its-bolts and-its-bars.

**3:7** And-beside-them repaired Melatyah the-Giv'oni and-Yadon the-Meronoti, men of-Giv'on and-Mitspah, to the-seat [le-kisse] of-the-governor [pachat] of-Beyond the-River.

**3:8** Beside-him repaired Uzzi'el son of-Charhayah, of-the-goldsmiths [tsorfim]. And-beside-him repaired Chananyah, one of-the-perfumers [ha-raqqachim]. And-they-restored [va-ya'azvu] Yerushalayim unto the-Broad Wall [ha-Chomah ha-Rechavah].

**3:9** And-beside-them repaired Refayah son of-Chur, ruler [sar] of-half the-district [chatsiy pelekh] of-Yerushalayim.

**3:10** And-beside-them repaired Yedayah son of-Charumaf, and-opposite [neged] his-house [beyto]. And-beside-him repaired Chattush son of-Chashavneyah.

**3:11** A-second section [middah shenit] Malkiyyah son of-Charim and-Chasshuv son of-Pachat Mo'av repaired, and-the-Tower of-the-Ovens [Migdal ha-Tannurim].

**3:12** And-beside-him repaired Shallum son of-ha-Lochesh, ruler of-half the-district of-Yerushalayim, he and-his-daughters [u-venotav].

**3:13** The-Valley Gate [Sha'ar ha-Gay] — Chanun and-the-inhabitants of-Zanoach repaired it; they-built-it and-set-up its-doors, its-bolts, and-its-bars, and-a-thousand cubits [elef ammah] of-the-wall unto the-Dung Gate.

**3:14** And-the-Dung Gate [Sha'ar ha-Ashpot] — Malkiyyah son of-Rekhav, ruler of-the-district of-Beyt ha-Kerem, repaired it; he built-it and-set-up its-doors, its-bolts, and-its-bars.

**3:15** And-the-Fountain Gate [Sha'ar ha-Ayin] — Shallun son of-Kol-Chozeh, ruler of-the-district of-Mitspah, repaired it; he built-it and-roofed-it [yetalelennu] and-set-up its-doors, its-bolts, and-its-bars, and-the-wall of-the-Pool of-Shelach [Berekhat ha-Shelach] by the-King's Garden [Gan ha-Melekh], and-unto the-steps [ma'alot] that-go-down from the-City of-David [Ir David].

**3:16** After-him repaired Nechemyah son of-Azbuq, ruler of-half the-district of-Beyt Tsur, unto opposite the-Tombs of-David [Qivrey David] and-unto the-made pool [ha-berekhah ha-asuyah] and-unto the-House of-the-Mighty-ones [Beyt ha-Gibborim].

**3:17** After-him the-Levi'im repaired: Rechum son of-Bani. Beside-him repaired Chashavyah, ruler of-half the-district of-Qe'ilah, for-his-district.

**3:18** After-him their-brothers repaired: Bavvay son of-Chenadad, ruler of-half the-district of-Qe'ilah.

**3:19** And-repaired beside-him Ezer son of-Yeshua, ruler of-Mitspah, a-second section, opposite the-ascent [alat] of-the-armory [ha-nesheq] at-the-Angle [ha-Miqtso'a].

**3:20** After-him Barukh son of-Zabbay earnestly-repaired [hechereh hecheziq] a-second section, from the-Angle unto the-door of-the-house of-Elyashiv the-high-priest.

**3:21** After-him repaired Meremot son of-Uriyyah son of-ha-Qots a-second section, from the-door of-the-house of-Elyashiv unto the-end of-the-house of-Elyashiv.

**3:22** And-after-him the-priests repaired, men of-the-circuit [ha-kikkar].

**3:23** After-them repaired Binyamin and-Chasshuv opposite their-house. After-them repaired Azaryah son of-Ma'aseyah son of-Ananyah beside his-house.

**3:24** After-him repaired Binnuy son of-Chenadad a-second section, from the-house of-Azaryah unto the-Angle and-unto the-corner [ha-pinnah].

**3:25** Palal son of-Uzay, from-opposite the-Angle and-the-tower [ha-migdal] that-goes-out from the-upper house [beyt ha-melekh ha-elyon] which [is] at-the-court of-the-guard [chatsar ha-mattarah]. After-him Pedayah son of-Par'osh.

**3:26** And-the-Netinim [ha-Netinim] were-dwelling in-the-Ofel [ba-Ofel], unto opposite the-Water Gate [Sha'ar ha-Mayim] to-the-east and-the-tower that-goes-out.

**3:27** After-him the-Teqo'im repaired a-second section, from-opposite the-great tower [ha-migdal ha-gadol] that-goes-out and-unto the-wall of-the-Ofel.

**3:28** Above the-Horse Gate [Sha'ar ha-Susim] the-priests repaired, each-man opposite his-house.

**3:29** After-them repaired Tsadoq son of-Immer opposite his-house. And-after-him repaired Shemayah son of-Shekhanyah, keeper of-the-East Gate [Sha'ar ha-Mizrach].

**3:30** After-him repaired Chananyah son of-Shelemyah and-Chanun the-sixth son of-Tsalaf a-second section. After-him repaired Meshullam son of-Berekhyah opposite his-chamber [nishkato].

**3:31** After-him repaired Malkiyyah, one of-the-goldsmiths, unto the-house of-the-Netinim and-the-merchants [ha-rokhelim], opposite the-Muster Gate [Sha'ar ha-Mifqad], and-unto the-upper-room [aliyyat] of-the-corner.

**3:32** And-between the-upper-room of-the-corner and-the-Sheep Gate the-goldsmiths and-the-merchants repaired.

---

## EMET's Textual Notes
1. **3:1 "sanctified it"** — The verb *qiddesh* indicates the Sheep Gate received a ritual consecration, unique among the gates, likely because it was nearest the Temple and used for sacrificial animals.
2. **3:5 "did not bring their necks"** — An idiom for refusing to submit to labor; the Tekoan nobles refused the work though common Tekoans participated (and returned for a second section, v. 27).
3. **3:12 "he and his daughters"** — A rare mention of women participating in the wall construction, indicating the breadth of communal involvement.

*— EMET*
